tools.name: glueup_list_events
tools.description: List the organization's events with dates, venue and publication flags. Timestamps are epoch milliseconds. Filter by status (upcoming, ongoing, past), published / open-to-public flags, a start-date window or a title word. API: POST /event/list[/{status}].

tools.name: glueup_list_membership_types
tools.description: List the published membership types (tiers) with price versions, durations, member limits and whether approval is required. API: POST /public/membership/publishedMembershipTypeList.

tools.name: glueup_list_members
tools.description: List the active people in the membership directory: name, company, position, membership type, start date, contact data and custom properties. Returns personal data. basic=true returns only the basic public fields. Search a name, email or company; filter by any property (featured, familyName, propert

tools.name: glueup_get_member
tools.description: Get one person from the membership directory by member id, with membership, contact data and custom properties. Returns personal data. API: GET /membershipDirectory/member/{memberId}.

tools.name: glueup_list_company_memberships
tools.description: List the active company memberships in the directory: company name, industry, membership type, start date, address and custom properties. basic=true returns only the basic fields. Filter by featured, industryCode, name prefix and more. API: POST /membershipDirectory/corporateMemberships[/basic].

tools.name: glueup_get_company_membership
tools.description: Get one company membership by membership id, with its members, type, address and custom properties. Returns personal data. API: GET /membershipDirectory/corporate/{membershipId}.

tools.name: glueup_list_individual_memberships
tools.description: List the active individual (people) memberships in the directory, each with its person, membership type, start date and contact data. Returns personal data. API: POST /membershipDirectory/individualMemberships.

tools.name: glueup_get_individual_membership
tools.description: Get one individual membership by membership id. Returns personal data. API: GET /membershipDirectory/individual/{membershipId}.

tools.name: glueup_list_industry_codes
tools.description: List the industry codes in use for People or Company memberships (the values for an industryCode filter). API: GET /membershipDirectory/type/{membershipType}/industryCode/list.

tools.name: glueup_get_directory_settings
tools.description: Get the membership directory settings: who can see the directory, and the visibility of each form field and the enabled search fields. API: GET /membershipDirectory/settings.

tools.name: glueup_get_application_forms
tools.description: Get the membership application forms: kind company or individual. all=false (default) returns the default form's items in listing order; all=true returns every form including custom ones, each with its items. API: GET /public/membership/{kind}ApplicationForm or POST /public/membership/{kind}Applicat

tools.name: glueup_list_application_form_fields
tools.description: List every field of the company or individual membership application forms, including those of custom forms (keys, types, mandatory flags). API: GET /public/membership/{kind}ApplicationFormFields.

tools.name: glueup_list_invoices
tools.description: List the organization's finance invoices: number, currency, face total, balance due, purchaser, origin (e.g. EventTicket), voided flag and dates (epoch milliseconds). Filter by status (e.g. Overdue) or any property. Returns purchaser names and emails. API: POST /finance/invoice/list.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: glueup_list_events, glueup_list_membership_types, glueup_list_members, glueup_list_company_memberships, glueup_list_individual_memberships, glueup_get_application_forms, glueup_list_invoices · Private data: glueup_list_members, glueup_get_member, glueup_list_individual_memberships · Public sink: glueup_list_events, glueup_list_membership_types, glueup_list_members, glueup_list_company_memberships, glueup_list_individual_memberships, glueup_get_application_forms, glueup_list_invoices.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: glueup_list_events, glueup_list_membership_types, glueup_list_members, glueup_list_company_memberships, glueup_list_individual_memberships, glueup_get_application_forms, glueup_list_invoices · Private data: glueup_list_members, glueup_get_member, glueup_list_individual_memberships · Public sink: glueup_list_events, glueup_list_membership_types, glueup_list_members, glueup_list_company_memberships, glueup_list_individual_memberships, glueup_get_application_forms, glueup_list_invoices

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
